newsitem.title: USA: Hollinger Int'l offering increased to $530 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hollinger Int'l offering increased to $530 mln.

text.p: Hollinger International Publishing Inc, a unit of Hollinger International Inc, increased the size of a two-tranche high-yield bond offering to $530 million from $400 million on Wednesday, according to market sources.
The first tranche of non-callable eight-year senior notes, originally set at $200 million, was upped to $265 million, sources said.
The tranche has price talk of 212.5 to 225 basis points over the 10-year U.S. Treasury note. It is rated Ba3 by Moody's Investors Service.
The second tranche of 10-year senior subordinated notes, which are non-callable for five years, was also increased from an original size of $200 million to $265 million.
Price talk on the second tranche is 275 to 287.5 basis points over Treasuries. It is rated B1 by Moody's Investors Services.
Both tranches were, as yet, unrated by Standard and Poor's.
Merrill Lynch & Co Inc, the underwriter of the deal, declined to comment.
Hollinger International is an international newspaper publishing company.
